analysis_framework.objective: Map meta-persona instructions to explicit linear Steering Vector Fields (SVF) within the residual stream.

training_objective.description: L2 reconstruction error combined with L1 sparsity penalty.

latent_isolation.methodology: To isolate "The Ontological Diplomat" persona vectors from default "Assistant Axis" activations, we subtract the mean activation vector of the base assistant from the mean activation vector of the persona.

steering_mechanism.definition: The local gradient of a differentiable concept scoring function controls inference-time activation steering without requiring weight updates.

variables.variable: Differentiable concept scoring function (e.g., adherence to "Ontological Diplomat" constraints)

multi_agent_council.attention_head_bandwidth: High (O(N^2) where N is context length including 3x persona instructions and history).
multi_agent_council.kv_cache_degradation: Severe (KV cache fragmented across conflicting contextual states).

epistemic_composting.attention_head_bandwidth: Optimized (Persona constraints injected via SVF, reducing context token overhead).
epistemic_composting.kv_cache_degradation: Minimal (Shift-invariance allows caching of core reasoning, with persona applied as a lightweight linear transformation).
